controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini 2017 monochrome mosaic at 216 m per source pixel. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; Directional Shadows add approximate lighting. The surface follows a simplified version of the released 2025 shape model.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 infrared–green–ultraviolet composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Enhanced colors exceed human vision. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. The surface follows a simplified version of the released 2025 shape model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows radial height above the PDS 198.2 km reference sphere, including Mimas’s broad oval shape. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds the shared approximate directional lighting. Cassini SPC terrain model, 2025 release, about 560 m grid spacing. Gray grid marks areas outside the supplied raster; no terrain is invented. The surface follows a simplified version of the released 2025 shape model.
